title: The AI era is creating a new CTO
excerpt: The CTO's new job in the AI era
content_html:
AI can already write production code, review pull requests, generate documentation, diagnose bugs, and propose architectural changes. Its influence now extends beyond developer productivity, affecting how engineering teams are organized, how decisions are made, and where technical authority rests.

CTOs, meanwhile, have always acted as orchestrators. Company growth gradually pulled their attention toward hiring leaders, setting architecture, resolving trade-offs, and improving team performance. Their influence flowed through the organization they built and the people they developed.

CTO at Genius.

AI now changes the organization beneath technical leaders. As of May 2026, Claude authored more than 80% of the code merged into Anthropic’s codebase, while the typical engineer merged eight times as much code per day during the second quarter of 2026 as in 2024. Engineers increasingly direct and review AI-generated work, while retaining responsibility for technical judgment, goal selection, and higher-level decisions.

Implementation and debugging can increasingly pass to coding agents, leaving engineers responsible for defining tasks, reviewing results, and deciding when human intervention is required.

The middle management tier consequently faces compression, while the CTO comes closer to execution because agent access, architectural rules, security controls, and release criteria affect the entire company.

The CTO’s responsibility is building a verification machine capable of producing sound technical decisions at high speed.

The middle tier compresses

Traditional engineering organizations have always grown through coordination. A CTO worked through vice presidents, directors, and engineering managers, each translating company priorities into technical plans. Managers assigned work, tracked delivery, resolved blockers, and kept teams aligned.

AI reduces much of this coordination burden. An engineer can describe a feature, ask an agent to inspect the codebase, generate an implementation, write tests, and prepare a pull request. More advanced systems can divide work across several agents and combine their output.

The engineer increasingly manages an AI development team, which compresses roles centered on task distribution and progress tracking. Human leadership retains its value through coaching, conflict resolution, recruitment, and professional growth, while coordination as a standalone function carries less leverage.

Responsibility, therefore, spreads in two directions:

Engineers gain greater ownership because they command far more productive capacity; CTOs become more involved in the systems governing this capacity because one weak permission rule or review gate can expose the entire company.

The distance between technical leadership and execution narrows. A CTO may write little application code, yet needs a precise understanding of how agents create, inspect, test, and deploy it. The role owns the engineering operating system governing people, agents, and software delivery.

The CTO’s verification machine

Verification is now the central technical challenge.

An AI system can generate several possible implementations during the time a human engineer once needed to produce one. This abundance creates a selection problem because companies must identify which implementation fits the architecture, meets security requirements, remains maintainable, and serves the product goal.

The CTO must design a system capable of making these judgments consistently.

Scoped permissions confine each agent to the files, databases, and services required for its assigned task. Automated evaluations test security, performance, and reliability, while agents review one another’s work before sensitive actions reach a human reviewer.

Human approval, however, loses value when engineers face a constant stream of requests that rarely require intervention. After several rounds of autonomous testing and review, most proposed changes arrive in acceptable condition.

Engineers grow accustomed to approving them, attention declines, and the exceptional case becomes harder to detect. Aviation, medicine, and nuclear operations have studied the same effect: repeated exposure to routine confirmations can turn oversight into habit.

Effective verification therefore depends on reducing the volume presented to humans. Routine and reversible actions can pass through automated controls, while unusual, irreversible, or high-impact decisions receive focused review. The interface should present evidence, alternatives, uncertainties, and possible consequences in a form that encourages scrutiny rather than a reflexive approval.

Firm boundaries remain essential. An agent may propose a database migration while execution requires human authorization. It may generate a deployment plan while production credentials remain outside its permissions. It may identify a vulnerability while changes to authentication controls receive senior review.

The system should also measure the quality of oversight through rejection rates, review times, escalation patterns, and the frequency with which human intervention changes an outcome. Human judgment offers the greatest value when attention is reserved for decisions where experience can alter the result.

Audit trails, rollback procedures, and ownership rules complete the machine by making every autonomous action attributable, inspectable, and reversible. These controls determine how an AI-enabled engineering organization behaves and require architectural judgment, security knowledge, product awareness, and an understanding of human behavior under pressure.

The CTO increasingly designs the conditions under which technical decisions emerge, turning individual judgment into a system capable of producing consistent quality without exhausting the people responsible for its highest-risk decisions.

Coding is abundant; judgment is not

AI lowers implementation costs, while software quality still depends on judgment.

A company can now produce more features, integrations, and experiments than its customers need. It can create technical debt faster than any human team and fill a codebase with locally correct changes capable of weakening the system over time.

Planning, testing, and prioritization consequently become the main constraints on engineering output. Strong organizations will know which problems deserve attention, how each feature supports the product, and where technical compromises create long-term costs.

Technical strategy gains value as implementation capacity grows.

Security is more important because agents can act across more systems at greater speed, while testing carries greater responsibility because generated code can appear persuasive while hiding subtle errors. Maintainability is harder as software volume grows faster than human comprehension.

AI commoditizes implementation and raises the value of technical judgment.

The strongest CTOs will turn judgment into repeatable mechanisms by encoding standards into evaluation suites, review policies, deployment gates, and agent instructions.

Privacy, trust, and security

AI systems increasingly retrieve information, make decisions, call external services, modify records, and trigger actions across business systems. Risk therefore depends on authority as much as intelligence.

An agent with access to customer records, payment systems, private repositories, and production environments carries enormous operational power. Prompt injection, compromised model providers, manipulated data sources, and unintended autonomous actions can become entry points into critical systems.

Privacy and trust become architectural concerns. CTOs must define model governance, data permissions, identity controls, and approval requirements. They also decide which information can enter third-party models, which tasks require isolated environments, and which actions always need human confirmation.

Agent identity is essential because companies need to know which agent performed an action, who authorized the task, which data informed the output, and which rules governed the process. Capability provides an incomplete standard because permission determines the level of risk.

After all, a mediocre model with production credentials is more dangerous than a brilliant one in a sandbox.

A strong AI engineering organization treats every agent as an active participant with a defined identity, a limited role, and an auditable history.

Users judge the product

Companies often present AI as a product feature because it attracts attention, although the largest gains may come from using it inside the development process.

Customers judge software by quality, reliability, safety, and speed of improvement. The number of agents contributing to a codebase carries little relevance to their experience. Competitive advantage comes from turning increased engineering capacity into better products while preserving trust.

AI therefore belongs primarily to the production side of the company. It helps engineers explore more implementations, test changes more thoroughly, respond to incidents faster, and improve existing features with greater frequency.

Product design still determines how much complexity reaches the customer and how effectively the software handles permissions, routing, configuration, and other operational decisions.

Customers experience the value of AI through faster product improvement, fewer defects, more responsive support, and software capable of adapting more effectively to their needs. The technology itself can remain largely invisible.

The CTO must ensure increased engineering capacity serves the product and strengthens the customer experience.

CTOs as product leaders

When implementation was expensive, product teams defined requirements and engineering teams built them. Limited development capacity made the division easier to maintain.

AI weakens this boundary because technical capability can influence product direction almost immediately. A CTO can explore several product concepts with agents, create working prototypes, and evaluate constraints before a conventional development cycle begins, bringing engineering into product decisions earlier.

The CTO must decide where automation improves the experience and where human involvement remains essential. Some decisions benefit from speed and consistency, while others require empathy, context, accountability, and careful interpretation of consequences.

These choices combine product judgment with technical judgment. Breadth gains value because AI can help technical leaders acquire deep knowledge of unfamiliar domains quickly, while the advantage comes from connecting engineering, security, customer needs, and business strategy into one coherent system.

Future CTOs will need to understand the complete product environment, including how the company operates, how customers experience it, and how autonomous systems participate in both.

From organization builder to machine builder

Earlier generations of CTOs were remembered for the organizations they created. Their legacy lived in the people they hired, the leaders they developed, the culture they established, and the engineers who continued advancing the company after they left.

AI adds another durable artifact through the agent fleet, permission model, evaluation systems, deployment gates, architectural constraints, and feedback mechanisms left behind by technical leadership. These components determine whether a company can continue producing software safely after senior leaders depart.

The Industrial Revolution expanded physical production by embedding human knowledge into machines and processes. AI can create a comparable expansion in software development by turning parts of technical reasoning into systems capable of continuous operation.

Small teams can build products once requiring entire departments, while established companies can test ideas and improve software at exceptional speed. The outcome depends on the quality of the machinery surrounding the models, because code generation alone can increase software volume while strong verification systems convert AI capacity into reliable innovation.

The next generation of CTOs will be remembered for the machine they leave behind, whose agents, permissions, gates, and evaluations allow humans and AI to keep producing better software long after its architect has gone.

sentences.zh: 自动化评估会测试安全性、性能和可靠性，而代理会在敏感操作到达人工审核员之前审核彼此的工作。

blocks.html_en: Human approval, however, loses value when engineers face a constant stream of requests that rarely require intervention. After several rounds of autonomous testing and review, most proposed changes arrive in acceptable condition.

sentences.en: Human approval, however, loses value when engineers face a constant stream of requests that rarely require intervention.
sentences.zh: 然而，当工程师面临源源不断且很少需要干预的请求时，人工批准就失去了价值。

sentences.en: After several rounds of autonomous testing and review, most proposed changes arrive in acceptable condition.
sentences.zh: 经过几轮自主测试和审查后，大多数提议的更改都达到了可接受的状态。

blocks.html_en: Engineers grow accustomed to approving them, attention declines, and the exceptional case becomes harder to detect. Aviation, medicine, and nuclear operations have studied the same effect: repeated exposure to routine confirmations can turn oversight into habit.

sentences.en: Engineers grow accustomed to approving them, attention declines, and the exceptional case becomes harder to detect.
sentences.zh: 工程师们逐渐习惯于批准它们，注意力下降，并且异常情况变得更难发现。

sentences.en: Aviation, medicine, and nuclear operations have studied the same effect: repeated exposure to routine confirmations can turn oversight into habit.
sentences.zh: 航空、医学和核行动研究了同样的效果：反复接触例行确认可以将监督变成习惯。

blocks.html_en: Effective verification therefore depends on reducing the volume presented to humans. Routine and reversible actions can pass through automated controls, while unusual, irreversible, or high-impact decisions receive focused review. The interface should present evidence, alternatives, uncertainties, and possible consequences in a form that encourages scrutiny rather than a reflexive approval.

sentences.en: Effective verification therefore depends on reducing the volume presented to humans.
sentences.zh: 因此，有效的验证取决于减少呈现给人类的体积。

sentences.en: Routine and reversible actions can pass through automated controls, while unusual, irreversible, or high-impact decisions receive focused review.
sentences.zh: 常规和可逆的行动可以通过自动化控制，而不寻常的、不可逆转的或高影响力的决策则受到重点审查。

sentences.en: The interface should present evidence, alternatives, uncertainties, and possible consequences in a form that encourages scrutiny rather than a reflexive approval.
sentences.zh: 界面应该以鼓励审查而不是反射性批准的形式呈现证据、替代方案、不确定性和可能的​​后果。

blocks.html_en: Firm boundaries remain essential. An agent may propose a database migration while execution requires human authorization. It may generate a deployment plan while production credentials remain outside its permissions. It may identify a vulnerability while changes to authentication controls receive senior review.

sentences.en: Firm boundaries remain essential.
sentences.zh: 严格的界限仍然至关重要。

sentences.en: An agent may propose a database migration while execution requires human authorization.
sentences.zh: 代理可能会建议数据库迁移，而执行则需要人工授权。

sentences.en: It may generate a deployment plan while production credentials remain outside its permissions.
sentences.zh: 它可能会生成部署计划，而生产凭据仍超出其权限。

sentences.en: It may identify a vulnerability while changes to authentication controls receive senior review.
sentences.zh: 当身份验证控制的更改接受高级审查时，它可能会发现漏洞。

blocks.html_en: The system should also measure the quality of oversight through rejection rates, review times, escalation patterns, and the frequency with which human intervention changes an outcome. Human judgment offers the greatest value when attention is reserved for decisions where experience can alter the result.

sentences.en: The system should also measure the quality of oversight through rejection rates, review times, escalation patterns, and the frequency with which human intervention changes an outcome.
sentences.zh: 该系统还应通过拒绝率、审查时间、升级模式以及人为干预改变结果的频率来衡量监督质量。

sentences.en: Human judgment offers the greatest value when attention is reserved for decisions where experience can alter the result.
sentences.zh: 当注意力集中在经验可以改变结果的决策上时，人类的判断力就能发挥最大的价值。

blocks.html_en: Audit trails, rollback procedures, and ownership rules complete the machine by making every autonomous action attributable, inspectable, and reversible. These controls determine how an AI-enabled engineering organization behaves and require architectural judgment, security knowledge, product awareness, and an understanding of human behavior under pressure.

sentences.en: Audit trails, rollback procedures, and ownership rules complete the machine by making every autonomous action attributable, inspectable, and reversible.
sentences.zh: 审计跟踪、回滚程序和所有权规则使每个自主操作都可归因、可检查和可逆，从而完善了机器。

sentences.en: These controls determine how an AI-enabled engineering organization behaves and require architectural judgment, security knowledge, product awareness, and an understanding of human behavior under pressure.
sentences.zh: 这些控制决定了人工智能工程组织的行为方式，并需要架构判断、安全知识、产品意识以及对压力下人类行为的理解。

blocks.html_en: The CTO increasingly designs the conditions under which technical decisions emerge, turning individual judgment into a system capable of producing consistent quality without exhausting the people responsible for its highest-risk decisions.

sentences.en: The CTO increasingly designs the conditions under which technical decisions emerge, turning individual judgment into a system capable of producing consistent quality without exhausting the people responsible for its highest-risk decisions.
sentences.zh: CTO 越来越多地设计技术决策出现的条件，将个人判断转变为能够产生一致质量的系统，而不会耗尽负责最高风险决策的人员的精力。

blocks.html_en: Coding is abundant; judgment is not

sentences.en: Coding is abundant; judgment is not
sentences.zh: 编码丰富；判断不是

blocks.html_en: AI lowers implementation costs, while software quality still depends on judgment.

sentences.en: AI lowers implementation costs, while software quality still depends on judgment.
sentences.zh: 人工智能降低了实施成本，而软件质量仍然取决于判断。

blocks.html_en: A company can now produce more features, integrations, and experiments than its customers need. It can create technical debt faster than any human team and fill a codebase with locally correct changes capable of weakening the system over time.

sentences.en: A company can now produce more features, integrations, and experiments than its customers need.
sentences.zh: 公司现在可以生产比客户需要的更多的功能、集成和实验。

sentences.en: It can create technical debt faster than any human team and fill a codebase with locally correct changes capable of weakening the system over time.
sentences.zh: 它可以比任何人类团队更快地产生技术债务，并用本地正确的更改填充代码库，随着时间的推移，这些更改会削弱系统。

blocks.html_en: Planning, testing, and prioritization consequently become the main constraints on engineering output. Strong organizations will know which problems deserve attention, how each feature supports the product, and where technical compromises create long-term costs.

sentences.en: Planning, testing, and prioritization consequently become the main constraints on engineering output.
sentences.zh: 因此，规划、测试和优先级划分成为工程输出的主要限制。

sentences.en: Strong organizations will know which problems deserve attention, how each feature supports the product, and where technical compromises create long-term costs.
sentences.zh: 强大的组织会知道哪些问题值得关注，每个功能如何支持产品，以及哪些技术妥协会造成长期成本。

blocks.html_en: Technical strategy gains value as implementation capacity grows.

sentences.en: Technical strategy gains value as implementation capacity grows.
sentences.zh: 随着实施能力的增强，技术战略的价值也随之增加。

blocks.html_en: Security is more important because agents can act across more systems at greater speed, while testing carries greater responsibility because generated code can appear persuasive while hiding subtle errors. Maintainability is harder as software volume grows faster than human comprehension.

sentences.en: Security is more important because agents can act across more systems at greater speed, while testing carries greater responsibility because generated code can appear persuasive while hiding subtle errors.
sentences.zh: 安全性更为重要，因为代理可以以更快的速度在更多系统上执行操作，而测试则承担更大的责任，因为生成的代码在隐藏细微错误的同时显得很有说服力。

sentences.en: Maintainability is harder as software volume grows faster than human comprehension.
sentences.zh: 由于软件数量的增长速度超过了人类的理解速度，因此可维护性变得更加困难。

blocks.html_en: AI commoditizes implementation and raises the value of technical judgment.

sentences.en: AI commoditizes implementation and raises the value of technical judgment.
sentences.zh: 人工智能使实施商品化并提高了技术判断的价值。

blocks.html_en: The strongest CTOs will turn judgment into repeatable mechanisms by encoding standards into evaluation suites, review policies, deployment gates, and agent instructions.

sentences.en: The strongest CTOs will turn judgment into repeatable mechanisms by encoding standards into evaluation suites, review policies, deployment gates, and agent instructions.
sentences.zh: 最强大的首席技术官将通过将标准编码到评估套件、审查策略、部署门和代理指令中，将判断转化为可重复的机制。

blocks.html_en: Privacy, trust, and security

sentences.en: Privacy, trust, and security
sentences.zh: 隐私、信任和安全

blocks.html_en: AI systems increasingly retrieve information, make decisions, call external services, modify records, and trigger actions across business systems. Risk therefore depends on authority as much as intelligence.

sentences.en: AI systems increasingly retrieve information, make decisions, call external services, modify records, and trigger actions across business systems.
sentences.zh: 人工智能系统越来越多地检索信息、做出决策、调用外部服务、修改记录以及跨业务系统触发操作。

sentences.en: Risk therefore depends on authority as much as intelligence.
sentences.zh: 因此，风险不仅取决于情报，还取决于权威。

blocks.html_en: An agent with access to customer records, payment systems, private repositories, and production environments carries enormous operational power. Prompt injection, compromised model providers, manipulated data sources, and unintended autonomous actions can become entry points into critical systems.

sentences.en: An agent with access to customer records, payment systems, private repositories, and production environments carries enormous operational power.
sentences.zh: 能够访问客户记录、支付系统、私人存储库和生产环境的代理拥有巨大的运营能力。

sentences.en: Prompt injection, compromised model providers, manipulated data sources, and unintended autonomous actions can become entry points into critical systems.
sentences.zh: 即时注入、受损的模型提供程序、受操纵的数据源和意外的自主操作都可能成为关键系统的入口点。

blocks.html_en: Privacy and trust become architectural concerns. CTOs must define model governance, data permissions, identity controls, and approval requirements. They also decide which information can enter third-party models, which tasks require isolated environments, and which actions always need human confirmation.

sentences.en: Privacy and trust become architectural concerns.
sentences.zh: 隐私和信任成为架构问题。

sentences.en: CTOs must define model governance, data permissions, identity controls, and approval requirements.
sentences.zh: CTO 必须定义模型治理、数据权限、身份控制和审批要求。

sentences.en: They also decide which information can enter third-party models, which tasks require isolated environments, and which actions always need human confirmation.
sentences.zh: 他们还决定哪些信息可以进入第三方模型，哪些任务需要隔离环境，以及哪些操作始终需要人工确认。

blocks.html_en: Agent identity is essential because companies need to know which agent performed an action, who authorized the task, which data informed the output, and which rules governed the process. Capability provides an incomplete standard because permission determines the level of risk.

sentences.en: Agent identity is essential because companies need to know which agent performed an action, who authorized the task, which data informed the output, and which rules governed the process.
sentences.zh: 代理身份至关重要，因为公司需要知道哪个代理执行了某个操作、谁授权了该任务、哪些数据通知输出以及哪些规则控制该流程。

sentences.en: Capability provides an incomplete standard because permission determines the level of risk.
sentences.zh: 能力提供了一个不完整的标准，因为权限决定了风险级别。

blocks.html_en: After all, a mediocre model with production credentials is more dangerous than a brilliant one in a sandbox.

sentences.en: After all, a mediocre model with production credentials is more dangerous than a brilliant one in a sandbox.
sentences.zh: 毕竟，具有生产资质的平庸模型比沙盒中的出色模型更危险。

blocks.html_en: A strong AI engineering organization treats every agent as an active participant with a defined identity, a limited role, and an auditable history.

sentences.en: A strong AI engineering organization treats every agent as an active participant with a defined identity, a limited role, and an auditable history.
sentences.zh: 强大的人工智能工程组织将每个代理视为积极的参与者，具有明确的身份、有限的角色和可审计的历史记录。

blocks.html_en: Users judge the product

sentences.en: Users judge the product
sentences.zh: 用户对产品的评价

blocks.html_en: Companies often present AI as a product feature because it attracts attention, although the largest gains may come from using it inside the development process.

sentences.en: Companies often present AI as a product feature because it attracts attention, although the largest gains may come from using it inside the development process.
sentences.zh: 公司经常将人工智能作为一种产品功能来展示，因为它吸引了人们的注意，尽管最大的收益可能来自于在开发过程中使用它。

blocks.html_en: Customers judge software by quality, reliability, safety, and speed of improvement. The number of agents contributing to a codebase carries little relevance to their experience. Competitive advantage comes from turning increased engineering capacity into better products while preserving trust.

sentences.en: Customers judge software by quality, reliability, safety, and speed of improvement.
sentences.zh: 客户通过质量、可靠性、安全性和改进速度来评判软件。

sentences.en: The number of agents contributing to a codebase carries little relevance to their experience.
sentences.zh: 为代码库做出贡献的代理数量与他们的经验无关。

sentences.en: Competitive advantage comes from turning increased engineering capacity into better products while preserving trust.
sentences.zh: 竞争优势来自于将增加的工程能力转化为更好的产品，同时保持信任。

blocks.html_en: AI therefore belongs primarily to the production side of the company. It helps engineers explore more implementations, test changes more thoroughly, respond to incidents faster, and improve existing features with greater frequency.

sentences.en: AI therefore belongs primarily to the production side of the company.
sentences.zh: 因此，人工智能主要属于公司的生产方面。

sentences.en: It helps engineers explore more implementations, test changes more thoroughly, respond to incidents faster, and improve existing features with greater frequency.
sentences.zh: 它可以帮助工程师探索更多的实现，更彻底地测试变更，更快地响应事件，并以更高的频率改进现有功能。

blocks.html_en: Product design still determines how much complexity reaches the customer and how effectively the software handles permissions, routing, configuration, and other operational decisions.

sentences.en: Product design still determines how much complexity reaches the customer and how effectively the software handles permissions, routing, configuration, and other operational decisions.
sentences.zh: 产品设计仍然决定着客户的复杂程度以及软件处理权限、路由、配置和其他操作决策的效率。

blocks.html_en: Customers experience the value of AI through faster product improvement, fewer defects, more responsive support, and software capable of adapting more effectively to their needs. The technology itself can remain largely invisible.

sentences.en: Customers experience the value of AI through faster product improvement, fewer defects, more responsive support, and software capable of adapting more effectively to their needs.
sentences.zh: 客户可以通过更快的产品改进、更少的缺陷、更灵敏的支持以及能够更有效地适应其需求的软件来体验人工智能的价值。

sentences.en: The technology itself can remain largely invisible.
sentences.zh: 技术本身在很大程度上仍然是不可见的。

blocks.html_en: The CTO must ensure increased engineering capacity serves the product and strengthens the customer experience.

sentences.en: The CTO must ensure increased engineering capacity serves the product and strengthens the customer experience.
sentences.zh: 首席技术官必须确保提高工程能力来服务于产品并增强客户体验。

blocks.html_en: CTOs as product leaders

sentences.en: CTOs as product leaders
sentences.zh: CTO 作为产品领导者

blocks.html_en: When implementation was expensive, product teams defined requirements and engineering teams built them. Limited development capacity made the division easier to maintain.

sentences.en: When implementation was expensive, product teams defined requirements and engineering teams built them.
sentences.zh: 当实施成本高昂时，产品团队定义需求并由工程团队构建它们。

sentences.en: Limited development capacity made the division easier to maintain.
sentences.zh: 有限的开发能力使得该部门更容易维护。

blocks.html_en: AI weakens this boundary because technical capability can influence product direction almost immediately. A CTO can explore several product concepts with agents, create working prototypes, and evaluate constraints before a conventional development cycle begins, bringing engineering into product decisions earlier.

sentences.en: AI weakens this boundary because technical capability can influence product direction almost immediately.
sentences.zh: 人工智能削弱了这个边界，因为技术能力几乎可以立即影响产品方向。

sentences.en: A CTO can explore several product concepts with agents, create working prototypes, and evaluate constraints before a conventional development cycle begins, bringing engineering into product decisions earlier.
sentences.zh: 首席技术官可以与代理一起探索多个产品概念，创建工作原型，并在传统开发周期开始之前评估约束条件，从而更早地将工程纳入产品决策中。

blocks.html_en: The CTO must decide where automation improves the experience and where human involvement remains essential. Some decisions benefit from speed and consistency, while others require empathy, context, accountability, and careful interpretation of consequences.

sentences.en: The CTO must decide where automation improves the experience and where human involvement remains essential.
sentences.zh: 首席技术官必须决定自动化在哪些方面可以改善体验，而人类的参与在哪些方面仍然至关重要。

sentences.en: Some decisions benefit from speed and consistency, while others require empathy, context, accountability, and careful interpretation of consequences.
sentences.zh: 有些决策受益于速度和一致性，而另一些决策则需要同理心、背景、责任感以及对后果的仔细解释。

blocks.html_en: These choices combine product judgment with technical judgment. Breadth gains value because AI can help technical leaders acquire deep knowledge of unfamiliar domains quickly, while the advantage comes from connecting engineering, security, customer needs, and business strategy into one coherent system.

sentences.en: These choices combine product judgment with technical judgment.
sentences.zh: 这些选择结合了产品判断和技术判断。

sentences.en: Breadth gains value because AI can help technical leaders acquire deep knowledge of unfamiliar domains quickly, while the advantage comes from connecting engineering, security, customer needs, and business strategy into one coherent system.
sentences.zh: 广度之所以有价值，是因为人工智能可以帮助技术领导者快速获取不熟悉领域的深入知识，而优势则来自于将工程、安全、客户需求和业务战略连接到一个连贯的系统中。

blocks.html_en: Future CTOs will need to understand the complete product environment, including how the company operates, how customers experience it, and how autonomous systems participate in both.

sentences.en: Future CTOs will need to understand the complete product environment, including how the company operates, how customers experience it, and how autonomous systems participate in both.
sentences.zh: 未来的首席技术官将需要了解完整的产品环境，包括公司如何运营、客户如何体验以及自主系统如何参与这两者。

blocks.html_en: From organization builder to machine builder

sentences.en: From organization builder to machine builder
sentences.zh: 从组织构建者到机器制造者

blocks.html_en: Earlier generations of CTOs were remembered for the organizations they created. Their legacy lived in the people they hired, the leaders they developed, the culture they established, and the engineers who continued advancing the company after they left.

sentences.en: Earlier generations of CTOs were remembered for the organizations they created.
sentences.zh: 前几代首席技术官因其创建的组织而被人们铭记。

sentences.en: Their legacy lived in the people they hired, the leaders they developed, the culture they established, and the engineers who continued advancing the company after they left.
sentences.zh: 他们的遗产存在于他们雇用的人员、他们培养的领导者、他们建立的文化以及他们离开后继续推动公司发展的工程师身上。

blocks.html_en: AI adds another durable artifact through the agent fleet, permission model, evaluation systems, deployment gates, architectural constraints, and feedback mechanisms left behind by technical leadership. These components determine whether a company can continue producing software safely after senior leaders depart.

sentences.en: AI adds another durable artifact through the agent fleet, permission model, evaluation systems, deployment gates, architectural constraints, and feedback mechanisms left behind by technical leadership.
sentences.zh: 人工智能通过代理队列、权限模型、评估系统、部署门、架构约束和技术领导留下的反馈机制添加了另一个持久的工件。

sentences.en: These components determine whether a company can continue producing software safely after senior leaders depart.
sentences.zh: 这些组件决定了公司在高级领导离职后是否可以继续安全地生产软件。

blocks.html_en: The Industrial Revolution expanded physical production by embedding human knowledge into machines and processes. AI can create a comparable expansion in software development by turning parts of technical reasoning into systems capable of continuous operation.

sentences.en: The Industrial Revolution expanded physical production by embedding human knowledge into machines and processes.
sentences.zh: 工业革命通过将人类知识嵌入机器和流程中扩大了物质生产。

sentences.en: AI can create a comparable expansion in software development by turning parts of technical reasoning into systems capable of continuous operation.
sentences.zh: 人工智能可以通过将部分技术推理转变为能够持续运行的系统，在软件开发方面实现类似的扩展。

blocks.html_en: Small teams can build products once requiring entire departments, while established companies can test ideas and improve software at exceptional speed. The outcome depends on the quality of the machinery surrounding the models, because code generation alone can increase software volume while strong verification systems convert AI capacity into reliable innovation.

sentences.en: Small teams can build products once requiring entire departments, while established companies can test ideas and improve software at exceptional speed.
sentences.zh: 小团队可以在需要整个部门的情况下构建产品，而成熟的公司可以以惊人的速度测试想法并改进软件。

sentences.en: The outcome depends on the quality of the machinery surrounding the models, because code generation alone can increase software volume while strong verification systems convert AI capacity into reliable innovation.
sentences.zh: 结果取决于模型周围机器的质量，因为仅代码生成就可以增加软件数量，而强大的验证系统则可以将人工智能能力转化为可靠的创新。

blocks.html_en: The next generation of CTOs will be remembered for the machine they leave behind, whose agents, permissions, gates, and evaluations allow humans and AI to keep producing better software long after its architect has gone.

sentences.en: The next generation of CTOs will be remembered for the machine they leave behind, whose agents, permissions, gates, and evaluations allow humans and AI to keep producing better software long after its architect has gone.
sentences.zh: 下一代首席技术官将因他们留下的机器而被铭记，机器的代理、权限、大门和评估使人类和人工智能在其架构师去世很久之后仍能继续生产更好的软件。

blocks.html_en: We've featured the best IT automation software.

sentences.en: We've featured the best IT automation software.
sentences.zh: 我们推出了最好的 IT 自动化软件。

sentences.en: This article was produced as part of TechRadar Pro Perspectives, our channel to feature the best and brightest minds in the technology industry today.
sentences.zh: 本文是 TechRadar Pro Perspectives 的一部分，这是我们的频道，旨在介绍当今技术行业中最优秀、最聪明的人才。

sentences.zh: 本文表达的观点仅代表作者的观点，并不一定代表 TechRadarPro 或 Future plc 的观点。

blocks.html_en: CTO at Genius.

sentences.en: CTO at Genius.
sentences.zh: Genius 的首席技术官。

content_html_zh:
人工智能已经可以编写生产代码、审查拉取请求、生成文档、诊断错误并提出架构更改建议。 它的影响现在已经超出了开发人员的生产力，影响着工程团队的组织方式、决策的制定方式以及技术权威的所在。

与此同时，首席技术官一直扮演着协调者的角色。 公司的发展逐渐将他们的注意力吸引到招聘领导者、设置架构、解决权衡和提高团队绩效上。 他们的影响力渗透到他们建立的组织和培养的人才中。

Genius 的首席技术官。

人工智能现在正在改变技术领导者领导下的组织。 截至 2026 年 5 月，Claude 编写的代码中有超过 80% 合并到了 Anthropic 的代码库中，而一般工程师在 2026 年第二季度每天合并的代码量是 2024 年的八倍。 工程师越来越多地指导和审查人工智能生成的工作，同时保留技术判断、目标选择和更高级别决策的责任。

实施和调试可以越来越多地传递给编码代理，让工程师负责定义任务、审查结果并决定何时需要人工干预。

因此，中层管理层面临压缩，而 CTO 则更接近执行，因为代理访问、架构规则、安全控制和发布标准影响整个公司。

首席技术官的职责是构建一个能够高速生成合理技术决策的验证机器。

中间层压缩

传统的工程组织总是通过协调而成长。 首席技术官与副总裁、总监和工程经理一起工作，每个人都将公司的优先事项转化为技术计划。 经理分配工作、跟踪交付、解决障碍并保持团队一致。

人工智能很大程度上减轻了这种协调负担。 工程师可以描述功能、要求代理检查代码库、生成实现、编写测试并准备拉取请求。 更先进的系统可以将工作分配给多个代理并合并它们的输出。

工程师越来越多地管理人工智能开发团队，该团队压缩了以任务分配和进度跟踪为中心的角色。 人类领导力通过辅导、冲突解决、招聘和职业发展来保留其价值，而协调作为独立职能的影响力较小。

因此，责任有两个方向：

工程师获得了更大的所有权，因为他们掌握了更多的生产能力；首席技术官更多地参与管理这一能力的系统，因为一个薄弱的权限规则或审查门可能会暴露整个公司。

技术领导力和执行力之间的距离正在缩小。 CTO 可能编写很少的应用程序代码，但需要准确了解代理如何创建、检查、测试和部署它。 该角色拥有管理人员、代理和软件交付的工程操作系统。

CTO 的验证机

验证现在是核心技术挑战。

人工智能系统可以在人类工程师曾经需要生成一种实现的同时生成多种可能的实现。 这种丰富性造成了选择问题，因为公司必须确定哪种实现适合架构、满足安全要求、保持可维护性并服务于产品目标。

CTO 必须设计一个能够一致做出这些判断的系统。

范围权限将每个代理限制为其分配的任务所需的文件、数据库和服务。 自动化评估会测试安全性、性能和可靠性，而代理会在敏感操作到达人工审核员之前审核彼此的工作。

然而，当工程师面临源源不断且很少需要干预的请求时，人工批准就失去了价值。 经过几轮自主测试和审查后，大多数提议的更改都达到了可接受的状态。

工程师们逐渐习惯于批准它们，注意力下降，并且异常情况变得更难发现。 航空、医学和核行动研究了同样的效果：反复接触例行确认可以将监督变成习惯。

因此，有效的验证取决于减少呈现给人类的体积。 常规和可逆的行动可以通过自动化控制，而不寻常的、不可逆转的或高影响力的决策则受到重点审查。 界面应该以鼓励审查而不是反射性批准的形式呈现证据、替代方案、不确定性和可能的​​后果。

严格的界限仍然至关重要。 代理可能会建议数据库迁移，而执行则需要人工授权。 它可能会生成部署计划，而生产凭据仍超出其权限。 当身份验证控制的更改接受高级审查时，它可能会发现漏洞。

该系统还应通过拒绝率、审查时间、升级模式以及人为干预改变结果的频率来衡量监督质量。 当注意力集中在经验可以改变结果的决策上时，人类的判断力就能发挥最大的价值。

审计跟踪、回滚程序和所有权规则使每个自主操作都可归因、可检查和可逆，从而完善了机器。 这些控制决定了人工智能工程组织的行为方式，并需要架构判断、安全知识、产品意识以及对压力下人类行为的理解。

CTO 越来越多地设计技术决策出现的条件，将个人判断转变为能够产生一致质量的系统，而不会耗尽负责最高风险决策的人员的精力。

编码丰富；判断不是

人工智能降低了实施成本，而软件质量仍然取决于判断。

公司现在可以生产比客户需要的更多的功能、集成和实验。 它可以比任何人类团队更快地产生技术债务，并用本地正确的更改填充代码库，随着时间的推移，这些更改会削弱系统。

因此，规划、测试和优先级划分成为工程输出的主要限制。 强大的组织会知道哪些问题值得关注，每个功能如何支持产品，以及哪些技术妥协会造成长期成本。

随着实施能力的增强，技术战略的价值也随之增加。

安全性更为重要，因为代理可以以更快的速度在更多系统上执行操作，而测试则承担更大的责任，因为生成的代码在隐藏细微错误的同时显得很有说服力。 由于软件数量的增长速度超过了人类的理解速度，因此可维护性变得更加困难。

人工智能使实施商品化并提高了技术判断的价值。

最强大的首席技术官将通过将标准编码到评估套件、审查策略、部署门和代理指令中，将判断转化为可重复的机制。

隐私、信任和安全

人工智能系统越来越多地检索信息、做出决策、调用外部服务、修改记录以及跨业务系统触发操作。 因此，风险不仅取决于情报，还取决于权威。

能够访问客户记录、支付系统、私人存储库和生产环境的代理拥有巨大的运营能力。 即时注入、受损的模型提供程序、受操纵的数据源和意外的自主操作都可能成为关键系统的入口点。

隐私和信任成为架构问题。 CTO 必须定义模型治理、数据权限、身份控制和审批要求。 他们还决定哪些信息可以进入第三方模型，哪些任务需要隔离环境，以及哪些操作始终需要人工确认。

代理身份至关重要，因为公司需要知道哪个代理执行了某个操作、谁授权了该任务、哪些数据通知输出以及哪些规则控制该流程。 能力提供了一个不完整的标准，因为权限决定了风险级别。

毕竟，具有生产资质的平庸模型比沙盒中的出色模型更危险。

强大的人工智能工程组织将每个代理视为积极的参与者，具有明确的身份、有限的角色和可审计的历史记录。

用户对产品的评价

公司经常将人工智能作为一种产品功能来展示，因为它吸引了人们的注意，尽管最大的收益可能来自于在开发过程中使用它。

客户通过质量、可靠性、安全性和改进速度来评判软件。 为代码库做出贡献的代理数量与他们的经验无关。 竞争优势来自于将增加的工程能力转化为更好的产品，同时保持信任。

因此，人工智能主要属于公司的生产方面。 它可以帮助工程师探索更多的实现，更彻底地测试变更，更快地响应事件，并以更高的频率改进现有功能。

产品设计仍然决定着客户的复杂程度以及软件处理权限、路由、配置和其他操作决策的效率。

客户可以通过更快的产品改进、更少的缺陷、更灵敏的支持以及能够更有效地适应其需求的软件来体验人工智能的价值。 技术本身在很大程度上仍然是不可见的。

首席技术官必须确保提高工程能力来服务于产品并增强客户体验。

CTO 作为产品领导者

当实施成本高昂时，产品团队定义需求并由工程团队构建它们。 有限的开发能力使得该部门更容易维护。

人工智能削弱了这个边界，因为技术能力几乎可以立即影响产品方向。 首席技术官可以与代理一起探索多个产品概念，创建工作原型，并在传统开发周期开始之前评估约束条件，从而更早地将工程纳入产品决策中。

首席技术官必须决定自动化在哪些方面可以改善体验，而人类的参与在哪些方面仍然至关重要。 有些决策受益于速度和一致性，而另一些决策则需要同理心、背景、责任感以及对后果的仔细解释。

这些选择结合了产品判断和技术判断。 广度之所以有价值，是因为人工智能可以帮助技术领导者快速获取不熟悉领域的深入知识，而优势则来自于将工程、安全、客户需求和业务战略连接到一个连贯的系统中。

未来的首席技术官将需要了解完整的产品环境，包括公司如何运营、客户如何体验以及自主系统如何参与这两者。

从组织构建者到机器制造者

前几代首席技术官因其创建的组织而被人们铭记。 他们的遗产存在于他们雇用的人员、他们培养的领导者、他们建立的文化以及他们离开后继续推动公司发展的工程师身上。

人工智能通过代理队列、权限模型、评估系统、部署门、架构约束和技术领导留下的反馈机制添加了另一个持久的工件。 这些组件决定了公司在高级领导离职后是否可以继续安全地生产软件。

工业革命通过将人类知识嵌入机器和流程中扩大了物质生产。 人工智能可以通过将部分技术推理转变为能够持续运行的系统，在软件开发方面实现类似的扩展。

小团队可以在需要整个部门的情况下构建产品，而成熟的公司可以以惊人的速度测试想法并改进软件。 结果取决于模型周围机器的质量，因为仅代码生成就可以增加软件数量，而强大的验证系统则可以将人工智能能力转化为可靠的创新。

下一代首席技术官将因他们留下的机器而被铭记，机器的代理、权限、大门和评估使人类和人工智能在其架构师去世很久之后仍能继续生产更好的软件。
